lines.en: Chica holds her place at the stage edge.
Her feet are fixed to the boards.
She only leans her upper body forward.
The tray still rests in her hands.

lines.zh: 她的关节卡住，迈不开步
lines.en: Her joints seize; she cannot step.
She rocks side to side as if to descend.

lines.zh: 翅膀随着动作张开了一点
lines.en: Her wings spread a fraction.
Her balance never leaves the stage.

lines.zh: 她试着挪动，只挪了半寸
lines.en: She tries to move and manages half an inch.
Her head moves first, body trailing.
She seems to wait for a song to begin.

lines.zh: 她站得很直，像被校正过
lines.en: She stands very straight, as if recalibrated.

lines.zh: 奇卡歪着头，嘴一直张着
lines.en: Chica's head tilts, mouth stuck open.
Her tray is empty.
Her beak clacks once.
Her wings fold in tight.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛一点点亮起来
lines.en: Her eyes brighten by degrees.
Dust settles on her lashes.

lines.zh: 她的手指在托盘边缘敲着
lines.en: Her fingers tap the tray's rim.
Her movement stops halfway.

lines.zh: 她抬头看向天花板上的灯
lines.en: She looks up at the ceiling lamp.
Her head drifts back level.

lines.zh: 她像在数房间里有几个人
lines.en: She seems to count the people in the room.

lines.zh: 她的内部传出很轻的电机声
lines.en: A faint motor hum comes from inside.

lines.zh: 她的围兜上沾着旧污渍
lines.en: Old stains mark her bib.

lines.zh: 她没有动，只是电机还在转
lines.en: She stays still; only the motor turns.

lines.zh: 奇卡的头转过来对着你
lines.en: Chica's head turns to face you.
Her beak opens wider.

lines.zh: 她歪着头，从上到下看你
lines.en: She tilts her head and looks you over.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛在你身上停了很久
lines.en: Her eyes hold on you a long time.
She lifts the tray toward you.
Her wings quiver.

lines.zh: 她好像要说什么，但没出声
lines.en: She looks about to speak and does not.

lines.zh: 她的头慢慢跟着你移动
lines.en: Her head follows you slowly.
Her feet do not shift at all.

lines.zh: 她站得比你还高半个头
lines.en: She stands half a head above you.

lines.zh: 她对你没有敌意，只有程序
lines.en: No hostility in her, only routine.

lines.zh: 她的视线落在你的手上
lines.en: Her gaze drops to your hands.
She lowers her head a little closer.

lines.zh: 她的喙碰出了一点轻响
lines.en: Her beak clicks faintly.

lines.zh: 她像在等你把东西放进托盘
lines.en: She seems to expect you to fill the tray.
Her head swings slowly back.
Her eyes dim a shade.

lines.zh: 她的嘴角位置被固定成笑
lines.en: Her mouth is fixed in a smile.
Chica is struck and the tray tips.
A crack opens in her casing.
Her beak hangs crooked.
The motor's hum turns shrill.
She cannot retreat; she only lists.
Her eyes flicker twice.
One wing sags halfway.

lines.zh: 羽毛状的部件掉了一片
lines.en: A feather-like plate drops off.
Her movements lag half a beat.

lines.zh: 她慢慢把头摆正，继续站着
lines.en: She levels her head and keeps standing.

lines.zh: 奇卡低头盯着你手里的东西
lines.en: Chica locks onto what you hold.

lines.zh: 她伸出托盘，示意你放上去
lines.en: She holds the tray out for you to fill.
Her hand reaches a little forward.

lines.zh: 她把东西在托盘上摆正
lines.en: She sets it straight on the tray.
Her beak opens and shuts twice.

lines.zh: 她拿起来看了看，又放下
lines.en: She lifts it, inspects it, and puts it down.

lines.zh: 她把东西藏进了围兜里
lines.en: She tucks it into her bib.

lines.zh: 她的翅膀高兴地抖了抖
lines.en: Her wings flutter with what passes for joy.
She reaches out for a second portion.
She hugs the tray and will not release it.

lines.zh: 你撞上奇卡，她只晃了晃
lines.en: You hit Chica; she only wobbles.
Her tray nearly slips.
She steadies it with her forearm.

lines.zh: 她被撞后没有退，只是歪
lines.en: She does not step back, only tilts.
Her wing knocks your shoulder.
You squeeze past her side.

lines.zh: 她的头随撞击轻轻一甩
lines.en: Her head lolls with the impact.
She slowly brings her balance back.

lines.zh: 灰从她的羽毛缝里落下
lines.en: Dust sifts from her feathered seams.

lines.zh: 她站在原地，像什么都没发生
lines.en: She stands as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 奇卡和另一具玩偶并排站着
lines.en: Chica stands beside another animatronic.

lines.zh: 两具身体都朝着舞台前方
lines.en: Both face the front of the stage.

lines.zh: 她们的托盘举得一样高
lines.en: Their trays are held at the same height.

lines.zh: 她们的头同时歪向一边
lines.en: Both heads tilt the same way.

lines.zh: 她们由一个控制器驱动
lines.en: One controller drives them both.

lines.zh: 灯光扫过她们，反射出湿光
lines.en: The light sweeps them and glints wet.
Their beaks open and close together.
Nothing passes between them.
They stand like that until morning.

lines.zh: 这一段程序里没有相伴
lines.en: No companionship exists in that routine.
Chica bends, stiffly.
Her tray tips a little.
She pinches the item up.
She sets it dead centre on the tray.
She studies it for a while.
What she dislikes, she pushes off.

lines.zh: 她把东西藏到围兜后面
lines.en: She hides it behind her bib.

lines.zh: 她的手卡在半空，没收回
lines.en: Her hand jams in midair.

lines.zh: 她把捡到的东西叠成一摞
lines.en: She stacks what she gathers.
She holds the tray, unable to retreat.
Chica's head whips toward you.
Her eyes flare too bright.
She brings the tray up to her chest.
Her beak opens fully.
The motor's pitch changes.

lines.zh: 她朝你倾过来，脚却没动
lines.en: She leans at you without moving her feet.
Her wings spread to full span.
Her movements pick up speed.

lines.zh: 她的头歪成一个奇怪的角度
lines.en: Her head cants at an odd angle.
She has added you to the list.

lines.zh: 她的身体朝前压，像要下台
lines.en: She presses forward as if to step down.

lines.zh: 她的喙撞在一起，响了一声
lines.en: Her beak snaps shut with a click.
Her eyes stop flickering.

lines.zh: 灯光在她背后聚成一圈
lines.en: The light haloes behind her.
She is waiting for the music to stop.
She raises one hand, slowly.

lines.zh: 奇卡一直朝着你的方向
lines.en: Chica keeps her face toward you.
Her head tracks you side to side.

lines.zh: 她的脚钉住，只有上身转
lines.en: Feet pinned, only her torso turns.
She lowers the tray by degrees.

lines.zh: 她的喙一开一合，像在数数
lines.en: Her beak opens and closes, counting.
Her wings stay raised.
She tries to advance and jams.
Her joints are trembling.
Her gaze has not left you.
She lowers her head low.
Her weight keeps tipping forward.
Her shadow sways across your feet.

lines.zh: 她像被线牵着，只差一步
lines.en: She looks pulled by a string, one step short.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛里有一小块暗影
lines.en: Something dark moves behind her eyes.
She goes entirely still.

lines.zh: 那静止比动作更不像好事
lines.en: That stillness is worse than motion.
Her hand rises and hangs there.
She is waiting for a command.
Chica slaps the tray across.
Her beak clamps on your shoulder.
She pushes at your chest.
Her wing sweeps your face.
She drives her whole torso forward.

lines.zh: 她的手指抓住你的衣袖
lines.en: Her fingers snag your sleeve.

lines.zh: 她的动作生硬却没有停顿
lines.en: Her motion is jerky but unbroken.

lines.zh: 托盘的边沿磕在你护甲上
lines.en: The tray's rim clangs on your armour.

lines.zh: 她打空了一次，第二次更近
lines.en: She misses once; the second lands closer.

lines.zh: 她把自己带得几乎跌倒
lines.en: The blow nearly tips her over.
Her hand comes again.
Her beak stays open after the strike.

lines.zh: 她把力气全压在前倾上
lines.en: All her force goes into the lean.

lines.zh: 她收回手，动作慢了半拍
lines.en: She pulls the hand back half a beat late.

lines.zh: 她的关节响得像要散架
lines.en: Her joints sound ready to come apart.

lines.zh: 这一下之后她静了一瞬
lines.en: After it she is still for an instant.
The lights come up on the stage.
Chica stands in the middle of the ring of light.
Her tray is held at her chest.
Her beak hangs slightly open.
Dust drifts down through the light.

lines.zh: 她身上的电机开始转动
lines.en: Her motors begin to turn.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛亮起两点白光
lines.en: Two white points light in her eyes.

lines.zh: 她的头一点一点转向观众
lines.en: Her head turns toward the audience, notch by notch.
She folds her wings first.
Her joints recalibrate one by one.

lines.zh: 她身上的旧污渍在光下很明显
lines.en: The old stains show clearly in the light.
She cannot take that step forward.
She stands there, waiting to begin.

lines.zh: 地板上留下两个固定的印子
lines.en: Two worn marks sit under her feet.

lines.zh: 幕布在她身后轻轻晃动
lines.en: The curtain sways behind her.

lines.zh: 她的托盘上反射出一道光
lines.en: A line of light catches her tray.
She looks larger than before.
She begins tonight's show.
Her cloth catches fire and the smile stays.

lines.zh: 摔下台时她的托盘飞了出去
lines.en: She falls off the stage; the tray flies free.

lines.zh: 水进外壳，她的眼睛灭了
lines.en: Water enters the casing and her eyes die.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了她半边羽毛
lines.en: The blast shreds half her plating.

lines.zh: 箭插进她的喙边，卡住了
lines.en: An arrow sticks beside her beak.

lines.zh: 怪力让她整个人抽了一下
lines.en: Odd force jerks her whole frame.

lines.zh: 她的电池快空了，动作迟滞
lines.en: Her battery runs low and her motion drags.

lines.zh: 雷击让她原地跳起又落下
lines.en: Lightning bounces her up and down.

lines.zh: 虚空拽她下去，她还在伸手
lines.en: The void pulls her; her hand still reaches.
